backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko actor with no implemented logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to files, components, and requirements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of key frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles with extensive OKLCH design tokens and light/dark theme variables.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point defining metadata, title, description, and root mounting element.
frontend/src/App.tsx: App component configuring client-side routes and wrapping pages with AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/home/FeaturedToo: Grid UI displaying featured tool cards with icons, badges, and hover interactions.
frontend/src/components/home/Footer.tsx: Responsive footer with branding, navigation links, categories, and social media icons.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Hero banner with headline, description, CTA buttons, and animated particle background.
frontend/src/components/home/IntroSectio: Introductory text section explaining the platform’s purpose and tool offerings.
frontend/src/components/home/ToolCategor: Renders a grid of tool category cards with icons, titles, and descriptions for the homepage.
frontend/src/components/home/ToolIconPar: Creates an animated canvas with floating icon-like particles that move and rotate based on screen size and motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Provides a basic page layout wrapper with a main content area and footer.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages creation and caching of a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context, handling login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/usePageSeo.ts: Updates the document title and meta description on mount and restores the originals on unmount.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file reserved for future React Query hooks with no current logic.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, component styles, and utility classes for the app.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and applies global styles.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Displays an About page with sections describing the platform’s mission, offerings, and benefits.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, error handling, and simulated submission feedback.
frontend/src/pages/DisclaimerPage.tsx: Renders the site's disclaimer page outlining warranties, limitations, and user responsibilities.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Composes the homepage by rendering hero, intro, categories, and featured tools sections.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Displays a styled 404 page with a link to return to the homepage.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPage.tsx: Provides a detailed privacy policy explaining data collection, usage, and browser‑only file handling.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Shows the terms and conditions describing service use, permitted activities, and policies.
frontend/src/pages/tools/PdfToWordOnline: Implements a PDF-to-Word tool with file selection, simulated conversion progress, and demo file download.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Defines a simple client-side router with navigation context, Link component, and route matching.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing site goals, architecture notes, existing features, and versioned project state for an online tools website.
